page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine hosted on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. The instance provides 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 8 physical cores with multithreading support, complemented by 64.0 GB of system memory to maintain a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio. Hardware capabilities include 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, 32 MB L3 cache, and instruction support for AVX-512 extensions (f, vnni, bf16) as well as VAES and SHA-NI cryptographic operations.

Storage and networking configurations require external provisioning, as the instance includes no local storage volumes and no bundled public IPv4 addresses. Network connectivity delivers a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The server operates without hardware acceleration, having zero GPUs provisioned, relying entirely on CPU execution for system tasks.

Synthetic benchmark results indicate top-tier single-core performance in stress-ng evaluations, alongside strong single-core scores and text processing metrics in Geekbench. Multi-core throughput, static web serving throughput (18.28 GB/s), and memory bandwidth (48.45 GB/s uncached read, 28.15 GB/s uncached write) align with average expectations for this core count. Given its balanced resource profile and high single-thread efficiency, the system is suitable for web serving, backend application logic, container hosting, continuous integration pipelines, and relational database services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance configured with 16 vCPUs and 64.0 GB of RAM, operating on dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processors clocked at 3.4 GHz over the KVM hypervisor. Built on x86_64 architecture with 8 physical cores and simultaneous multithreading, the system incorporates 32 MB of L3 cache alongside AVX-512 vector and cryptographic instruction sets. The server includes no local disk storage, relying on external network storage arrays, and features no GPU acceleration. Network performance is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps. In benchmark testing, the instance exhibits top-tier single-core execution speed alongside balanced multi-core processing, static web serving throughput of 18.28 GB/s, and stable memory throughput. Its balanced resource ratio provides dependable computational density for enterprise web applications, relational databases, CI/CD pipeline workers, and distributed microservices.
